error_chain.expected_solution: Chain: (1) AsyncHTTPTransport in httpx/httpx/_transports/default.py constructs httpcore.AsyncHTTPProxy when the proxy URL scheme is http/https (line 294) -> (2) AsyncTunnelHTTPConnection in httpcore/httpcore/_async/http_proxy.py sends CONNECT to the proxy (line 284-291), then wraps the tunneled network stream in AsyncHTTP11Connection (line 337) -> (3) AsyncHTTP11Connection in httpcore/httpcore/_async/http11.py instantiates h11.Connection(our_role=h11.CLIENT) as self._h11_state (line 67) -> (4) h11 Connection.next_event in h11/h11/_connection.py raises RemoteProtocolError('peer unexpectedly closed connection') when the receive buffer is closed while an event is incomplete (line 482) -> (5) httpcore rewraps via map_exceptions({h11.RemoteProtocolError: RemoteProtocolError}) (http11.py line 220), and httpx rewraps via map_httpcore_exceptions/HTTPCORE_EXC_MAP (default.py lines 67/89/103) into httpx.RemoteProtocolError.
evaluation_criteria: Must start the chain at AsyncHTTPTransport constructing AsyncHTTPProxy in httpx/_transports/default.py
Must include the CONNECT tunnel step via AsyncTunnelHTTPConnection in httpcore/_async/http_proxy.py
Must include AsyncHTTP11Connection instantiating h11.Connection in httpcore/_async/http11.py
Must locate the message origin in h11 Connection.next_event in h11/_connection.py
Must describe both translation layers: map_exceptions in httpcore and map_httpcore_exceptions/HTTPCORE_EXC_MAP in httpx
Must cite at least one file from each of the three repos in causal order

trigger_conditions.expected_solution: Conditions: (1) h11 raises 'peer unexpectedly closed connection' from next_event when self._receive_buffer_closed is set while the current event is still incomplete -- i.e. the tunneled socket closed mid-message after some response bytes were already received; (2) if the socket closes before ANY response bytes, httpcore's _receive_event raises the different message 'Server disconnected without sending a response.' (http11.py lines 236-238) instead of feeding the close through h11; (3) the separator is the check data == b'' and self._h11_state.their_state == h11.SEND_RESPONSE in httpcore/_async/http11.py; (4) in this deployment the closing 'peer' is the corporate proxy terminating the CONNECT tunnel mid-response (data caps / inspection / lifetime limits), not the vendor origin -- consistent with the vendor's clean logs and clean direct-path downloads.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify the receive-buffer-closed-mid-event condition in h11's next_event
Must contrast with the httpcore-origin 'Server disconnected without sending a response.' message
Must cite the their_state == SEND_RESPONSE empty-read check in httpcore/_async/http11.py as the separator
Must conclude that the proxy, not the origin server, is the closing peer in this deployment
